## Identifying LGBQ and study sample

```{r lgbtq}
BRFSS_all$LGBQ <- ifelse((BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 7 |
                          BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 9 ), NA, 
                 (ifelse((BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 1), 1, 
                 (ifelse(BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 3 |
                         BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 4, 2, 0))))) 
BRFSS_all$LGBQ_bin <- ifelse((BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 7 |
                              BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 9 ), NA, 
                     (ifelse(BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 1 | 
                             BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 3 |
                             BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 4, 1, 0)))
BRFSS_all$LGBQ_bis <- ifelse((BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 1 |
                              BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 7 |
                              BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 9 ), NA, 
                     (ifelse(BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 3 |
                             BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 4, 1, 0)))
BRFSS_all$LGBQ_les <- ifelse((BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 3 |
                              BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 4 |
                              BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 7 |
                              BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 9 ), NA, 
                     (ifelse(BRFSS_all$Orient_Female == 1, 1, 0)))
# BRFSS_all$Transgender <- ifelse((BRFSS_all$Transgender == 2 | 
#                                  BRFSS_all$Transgender == 3), 1,
#                          ifelse((BRFSS_all$Transgender == 7 | 
#                                  BRFSS_all$Transgender == 9), NA, 0))

# State with SDOH and SOGI modules
BRFSS_all$Sample_State <- ifelse((BRFSS_all$Year == 2024 &
                                  BRFSS_all$State %in% c(1,2,4,10,13,15,16,18,19,20,22,24,25,27,30,34,35,37,38,44,49,54,55,78)) |
                                 (BRFSS_all$Year == 2022 &
                                  BRFSS_all$State %in% c(2,9,10,13,18,19,20,25,27,29,30,32,35,37,44,48,49,50,53,54,55)), 1, 0)

# Study sample for breast cancer screening
BRFSS_all$Personal_history <- as.numeric(BRFSS_all$CancerType %in% c(5, 18))
BRFSS_all$Sample_ElgBC <- ifelse(BRFSS_all$Age >= 50 &  
                                 BRFSS_all$Age < 75 & 
                                 BRFSS_all$Sex == 2 &
                                 BRFSS_all$Sample_State == 1 &
                                 BRFSS_all$Personal_history != 1 &
                                 !is.na(BRFSS_all$LGBQ_bin) &
                                 !is.na(BRFSS_all$BC_Ever) &
                                 !is.na(BRFSS_all$BC_UTD), 1, 0)

# Aged 40-75 in case needed
BRFSS_all$Sample_ElgBC40 <- ifelse(BRFSS_all$Age >= 40 &  
                                   BRFSS_all$Age < 75 & 
                                   BRFSS_all$Sex == 2 &
                                   BRFSS_all$Sample_State == 1 &
                                   BRFSS_all$Personal_history != 1 &
                                   !is.na(BRFSS_all$LGBQ_bin) &  
                                   !is.na(BRFSS_all$BC_Ever) & 
                                   !is.na(BRFSS_all$BC_UTD), 1, 0)

# Flow chart
BRFSS_all$Flow_chart     <- ifelse(BRFSS_all$Age >= 50 &  
                                   BRFSS_all$Age < 75 & 
                                   BRFSS_all$Sex == 2 &
                                   BRFSS_all$Sample_State == 1, 1, 0)
table(BRFSS_all$LGBQ_bin, BRFSS_all$Flow_chart)

# table(BRFSS_all$LGBQ, BRFSS_all$Sample_ElgBC)
# 
#          0      1
#   0 166358  77110
#   1   3321   1237
#   2  14591   2086
```

## Flag complete case

```{r complete}
# All covariates
BRFSS_complete_all <- BRFSS_all %>%
  select(ID, PSU, Strata, Weight_2, Sample_ElgBC, Sample_ElgBC40, BC_Ever, BC_UTD, LGBQ_bin, LGBQ,
         HouseIns, TransIns, UtilityIns, FoodStamp, EmployIns, FoodIns, EmoSupport,
         Age, Age_Cat, Age_Cat2, Race, Urban, Region, Edu, Marital_Cat, Employ, Hlthplan, Wellness, RegSource, MED_Dff, HLTHSTAT, Chronic_Cat) %>%
         #DrinkBinge, Smoke, PhyAct
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(tolower(.) == "missing", NA, .))) %>%
  mutate(flag_complete_all = ifelse(complete.cases(.) & Sample_ElgBC == 1, 1, 0))
BRFSS_all$flag_complete_all <- BRFSS_complete_all$flag_complete_all

# Only UMN
BRFSS_complete_UMN <- BRFSS_all %>%
  select(ID, PSU, Strata, Weight_2, Sample_ElgBC, Sample_ElgBC40, BC_Ever, BC_UTD, LGBQ_bin, LGBQ,
         HouseIns, TransIns, UtilityIns, FoodStamp, EmployIns, FoodIns, EmoSupport) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(tolower(.) == "missing", NA, .))) %>%
  mutate(flag_complete_UMN = ifelse(complete.cases(.) & Sample_ElgBC == 1, 1, 0))
BRFSS_all$flag_complete_UMN <- BRFSS_complete_UMN$flag_complete_UMN

# At least 1 UMN
BRFSS_complete_one <- BRFSS_all %>%
  select(ID, PSU, Strata, Weight_2, Sample_ElgBC, Sample_ElgBC40, BC_Ever, BC_UTD, LGBQ_bin, LGBQ,
         HouseIns, TransIns, UtilityIns, FoodStamp, EmployIns, FoodIns, EmoSupport) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(tolower(.) == "missing", NA, .))) %>%
  mutate(flag_complete_one = ifelse(
    rowSums(!is.na(pick(HouseIns, TransIns, UtilityIns, FoodStamp, EmployIns, FoodIns, EmoSupport))) > 0 &
    Sample_ElgBC == 1,
    1, 0
  ))
BRFSS_all$flag_complete_one <- BRFSS_complete_one$flag_complete_one

write_dta(BRFSS_all, "BRFSS_all.dta")

table(BRFSS_all$LGBQ, BRFSS_all$flag_complete_all, BRFSS_all$Sample_ElgBC)
table(BRFSS_all$LGBQ, BRFSS_all$flag_complete_UMN, BRFSS_all$Sample_ElgBC)
table(BRFSS_all$LGBQ, BRFSS_all$flag_complete_one, BRFSS_all$Sample_ElgBC)

#     0     1     2 
# 65080   1055  1675 

#     0     1     2 
# 71588   1151  1915 

#     0     1     2 
# 73252   1164  1972 
```

## Final data

```{r final_data}
# For descriptive analysis
BRFSS_final <- BRFSS_all %>%
               select(ID, PSU, Strata, Weight_2, Sample_ElgBC, Sample_ElgBC40, BC_Ever, BC_UTD, LGBQ_bin, LGBQ, LGBQ_bis, 
                      flag_complete_all, flag_complete_UMN, flag_complete_one,
                      HouseIns, TransIns, UtilityIns, FoodStamp, EmployIns, FoodIns, EmoSupport,
                      HouseIns_prev, TransIns_prev, UtilityIns_prev, FoodStamp_prev, EmployIns_prev, FoodIns_prev, EmoSupport_prev,
                      Age, Age_Cat, Age_Cat2, Race, Urban, Region, Edu, Marital_Cat, Income_Cat, Employ,
                      HLTHSTAT, Chronic, Chronic_Cat,
                      Hlthplan, RegSource, MED_Dff, Wellness,
                      DrinkBinge, PhyAct, Smoke)

# For decomposition
BRFSS_dum <- BRFSS_all %>%
             select(ID, PSU, Strata, Weight_2, Sample_ElgBC, Sample_ElgBC40, BC_Ever, BC_UTD, LGBQ_bin, LGBQ, LGBQ_bis, 
                    flag_complete_all, flag_complete_UMN, flag_complete_one,
                    EmoSupport_Yes, EmployIns_Yes, FoodIns_Yes, FoodStamp_Yes, HouseIns_Yes, TransIns_Yes, UtilityIns_Yes,
                    EmoSupport_MIS, EmployIns_MIS, FoodIns_MIS, FoodStamp_MIS, HouseIns_MIS, TransIns_MIS, UtilityIns_MIS,
                    Age, Race_BL, Race_OT, Race_ML, Race_HI, Race_MI, 
                    Region_SO, Region_MW, Region_WT, 
                    Urban_No, Urban_MI, 
                    Edu_LHS, Edu_HSG, Edu_ASS, Edu_MIS,
                    Employ_No, Employ_MIS,
                    Marital_Div, Marital_Nev, Marital_MIS,
                    Ins_No, Ins_MIS, 
                    Reg_No, Reg_MIS,
                    Med_Yes, Med_MIS,
                    Inc_1, Inc_2, Inc_MIS,
                    Wellness_No, Wellness_MIS,
                    Chronic_Yes, Chronic_MIS,
                    HLTHSTAT_POOR, HLTHSTAT_MIS,
                    DrinkBinge_Yes, DrinkBinge_MIS,
                    PhyAct_No, PhyAct_MIS,
                    Smoke_Current, Smoke_Former, Smoke_MIS)

write_dta(BRFSS_all, "BRFSS_all.dta")
write_dta(BRFSS_dum, "BRFSS_dum.dta")
write_dta(BRFSS_final, "BRFSS_final.dta")

save(BRFSS_all, file = "BRFSS_all.RData")
save(BRFSS_dum, file = "BRFSS_dum.RData")
save(BRFSS_final, file = "BRFSS_final.RData")

```


## Survey data

```{r survey data}
setwd(dir)

load("./03.Code/BRFSS_dum.RData")
load("./03.Code/BRFSS_final.RData")

f.svy_set <- function(data_in) {
  data_out <- svydesign(id = ~PSU,
                        strata  = ~Strata,
                        weights = ~Weight_2,
                        nest    = TRUE,
                        data    = data_in)
}
options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")

set.BRFSS_final <- f.svy_set(BRFSS_final)
set.BRFSS_dum   <- f.svy_set(BRFSS_dum)

sub.BRFSS_final <- subset(set.BRFSS_final, flag_complete_UMN == 1)
sub.BRFSS_dum   <- subset(set.BRFSS_dum, flag_complete_UMN == 1)
```

## Check missingness

```{r missing}
sample <- BRFSS_all[BRFSS_all$Sample_ElgBC ==1,]
sample %>%
  group_by(LGBQ_bin) %>%
  summarise(across(c(EmoSupport, EmployIns, FoodStamp,FoodIns, HouseIns,UtilityIns,TransIns),
                   ~mean(. == "1", na.rm = F) * 100)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-LGBQ_bin,
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "pct_missing")

sample <- BRFSS_all[BRFSS_all$Sample_ElgBC ==1,]
sample %>%
  group_by(LGBQ_bin) %>%
  summarise(across(flag_complete_all, ~mean(. == 0, na.rm = F) * 100)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-LGBQ_bin,
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "pct_missing")
sample %>%
  group_by(LGBQ_bin) %>%
  summarise(across(flag_complete_UMN, ~mean(. == 0, na.rm = F) * 100)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-LGBQ_bin,
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "pct_missing")
sample %>%
  group_by(LGBQ_bin) %>%
  summarise(across(flag_complete_one, ~mean(. == 0, na.rm = F) * 100)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-LGBQ_bin,
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "pct_missing")


ci_BC_UTD        <- svyciprop(~BC_UTD, subset(set.BRFSS_final,  Sample_ElgBC == 1), method = "logit")
ci_BC_UTD_str    <- svyciprop(~BC_UTD, subset(set.BRFSS_final,  Sample_ElgBC == 1 & LGBQ_bin == 0), method = "logit")
ci_BC_UTD_lgbq   <- svyciprop(~BC_UTD, subset(set.BRFSS_final,  Sample_ElgBC == 1 & LGBQ_bin == 1), method = "logit")
ci_BC_UTD_les    <- svyciprop(~BC_UTD, subset(set.BRFSS_final,  Sample_ElgBC == 1 & LGBQ == 1), method = "logit")
ci_BC_UTD_bis    <- svyciprop(~BC_UTD, subset(set.BRFSS_final,  Sample_ElgBC == 1 & LGBQ == 2), method = "logit")

cat(paste0(round(ci_BC_UTD[1] * 100, 1), " (", round(attr(ci_BC_UTD, "ci")[1] * 100, 1),"-",  round(attr(ci_BC_UTD, "ci")[2] * 100, 1), ")"), sep = "\n")
cat(paste0(round(ci_BC_UTD_str[1] * 100, 1), " (", round(attr(ci_BC_UTD_str, "ci")[1] * 100, 1),"-",  round(attr(ci_BC_UTD_str, "ci")[2] * 100, 1), ")"), sep = "\n")
cat(paste0(round(ci_BC_UTD_lgbq[1] * 100, 1), " (", round(attr(ci_BC_UTD_lgbq, "ci")[1] * 100, 1),"-",  round(attr(ci_BC_UTD_lgbq, "ci")[2] * 100, 1), ")"), sep = "\n")
cat(paste0(round(ci_BC_UTD_les[1] * 100, 1), " (", round(attr(ci_BC_UTD_les, "ci")[1] * 100, 1),"-",  round(attr(ci_BC_UTD_les, "ci")[2] * 100, 1), ")"), sep = "\n")
cat(paste0(round(ci_BC_UTD_bis[1] * 100, 1), " (", round(attr(ci_BC_UTD_bis, "ci")[1] * 100, 1),"-",  round(attr(ci_BC_UTD_bis, "ci")[2] * 100, 1), ")"), sep = "\n")

dat <- expand.grid(
  indicator = c("Total",
                "Straight",
                "LGBQ",
                "Lesbian/Gay",
                "Bisexual/Queer"
                ),
  group     = c("With complete HRSN data", "Missing any HRSN data", "All eligible women")) %>%
  mutate(prev = c(79.4, 79.6, 74.5, 79.2, 71.8,
                  75.4, 76.1, 61.2, 63.2, 60.5,
                  79.1, 79.3, 73.2, 78.0, 70.5),
         lcl  = c(78.8, 79.0, 69.6, 74.1, 64.9,
                  73.0, 73.7, 46.0, 43.8, 40.9, 
                  78.5, 78.7, 68.5, 73.1, 64.0),
         ucl  = c(80.0, 80.2, 78.8, 83.5, 77.9,
                  77.6, 78.3, 74.5, 79.0, 77.2,
                  79.6, 79.9, 77.3, 82.2, 76.3))

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.8)

ggplot(dat, aes(x = indicator, y = prev, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl),
                position = dodge, width = 0.25,
                linewidth = 0.4, color = "gray25") +
  #coord_flip() +                                              
  scale_x_discrete(limits = levels(dat$indicator)) +     
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#9E9E9E", "#DDDDDD", "#4D4D4D")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Prevalence (%)") +
  labs(x = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),                 
        legend.position = "top")
```

## Table 1

```{r table 1}

n_uw   <- as.numeric(table(BRFSS_final[BRFSS_final$flag_complete_UMN == 1,]$LGBQ_bin))
n_w    <- svytable(~LGBQ_bin, sub.BRFSS_final)
prop_w <- as.numeric(prop.table(svytable(~LGBQ_bin, sub.BRFSS_final)) * 100)
n_uw_overall <- sum(n_uw)
n_w_overall  <- sum(n_w)


#### Age -----------------------------------------------------------------------
n_Age         <- round(as.numeric(table(BRFSS_final[BRFSS_final$flag_complete_UMN == 1,]$Age_Cat)), 0)

prop_Wellness_str  <- round(as.numeric(prop.table(svytable(~Wellness, subset(set.BRFSS_final, flag_complete_UMN == 1 & LGBQ_bin == 0)))) * 100, 1)
n_Wellness_lgbq    <- round(as.numeric(table(BRFSS_final[BRFSS_final$flag_complete_UMN == 1 & BRFSS_final$LGBQ_bin == 1,]$Wellness)), 0)
prop_Wellness_lgbq <- round(as.numeric(prop.table(svytable(~Wellness, subset(set.BRFSS_final, flag_complete_UMN == 1 & LGBQ_bin == 1)))) * 100, 1)
n_Wellness_les     <- round(as.numeric(table(BRFSS_final[BRFSS_final$flag_complete_UMN == 1 & BRFSS_final$LGBQ == 1,]$Wellness)), 0)
prop_Wellness_les  <- round(as.numeric(prop.table(svytable(~Wellness, subset(set.BRFSS_final, flag_complete_UMN == 1 & LGBQ == 1)))) * 100, 1)
n_Wellness_bis     <- round(as.numeric(table(BRFSS_final[BRFSS_final$flag_complete_UMN == 1 & BRFSS_final$LGBQ == 2,]$Wellness)), 0)
prop_Wellness_bis  <- round(as.numeric(prop.table(svytable(~Wellness, subset(set.BRFSS_final, flag_complete_UMN == 1 & LGBQ == 2)))) * 100, 1)

cat(paste0(prop_Wellness, " (", format(n_Wellness, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE), ")"), sep = "\n")
cat(paste0(prop_Wellness_str, " (", format(n_Wellness_str, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE), ")"), sep = "\n")
cat(paste0(prop_Wellness_lgbq, " (", format(n_Wellness_lgbq, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE), ")"), sep = "\n")
```

## Attenuation

```{r attenuation}
demo    <- c("Age", "Race", "Region", "Urban")
ses     <- c("Edu", "Employ", "Marital_Cat", "Income_Cat")
health  <- c("HLTHSTAT", "Chronic_Cat")
access  <- c("Hlthplan", "RegSource", "Wellness", "MED_Dff")
umn     <- c("EmoSupport", "EmployIns", "FoodIns", "FoodStamp",
             "HouseIns", "TransIns", "UtilityIns")

models <- list(
  M1_crude   = c("LGBQ_bis"),
  M2_demo    = c("LGBQ_bis", demo),
  M3_ses     = c("LGBQ_bis", demo, ses),
  M4_health  = c("LGBQ_bis", demo, ses, health),
  M5_access  = c("LGBQ_bis", demo, ses, health, access),
  M6_umn     = c("LGBQ_bis", demo, ses, health, access, umn)
)

fit_one <- function(rhs_vars, design, outcome = "BC_UTD") {
  f <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", paste(rhs_vars, collapse = " + ")))
  svyglm(f, design = design, family = quasibinomial())
}

fits <- lapply(models, fit_one, design = subset(set.BRFSS_final, flag_complete_UMN == 1))

extract_lgbq <- function(fit) {
  s <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  row <- s["LGBQ_bis", ]
  c(beta = row[1], se = row[2],
    OR = exp(row[1]),
    OR_lo = exp(row[1] - 1.96 * row[2]),
    OR_hi = exp(row[1] + 1.96 * row[2]),
    p = row[4])
}

att_tab <- t(sapply(fits, extract_lgbq))
att_tab <- as.data.frame(att_tab)
att_tab$model <- rownames(att_tab)

# % attenuation relative to crude
beta_crude <- att_tab$beta[1]
att_tab$pct_attenuation <- (beta_crude - att_tab$beta) / beta_crude * 100

# Incremental attenuation
att_tab$incremental_pct <- c(NA, -diff(att_tab$beta) / beta_crude * 100)

print(att_tab[, c("model", "beta.Estimate", "OR.Estimate", "OR_lo.Estimate", "OR_hi.Estimate", "p.Pr(>|t|)",
                  "pct_attenuation", "incremental_pct")],
      row.names = FALSE)

```

## Prevalence figure

```{r Figures}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# long format: one row per indicator × group
dat <- expand.grid(
  indicator = c("Food insecurity",
                "Receiving food stamps (SNAP)",
                "Housing insecurity",
                "Employment insecurity",
                "Utility insecurity",
                "Lack of social and emotional support",
                "Transportation insecurity"
                ),
  group     = c("Straight", "LGBQ", "Lesbian/gay", "Bisexual/queer")) %>%
  mutate(prev = c(12.2, 9.8,  9.2,  7.5,  6.6, 6.5,  5.8,   
                  19.1, 17.1, 17.0, 12.0, 9.7, 8.9,  12.6,   
                  10.7, 10.7, 11.6, 6.5, 8.7, 5.1,  4.7,   
                  23.8, 20.8, 20.1, 15.1, 10.2, 11.0, 17.1),
         lcl  = c(11.7, 9.3, 8.7, 7.1, 6.2, 6.1, 5.4,  
                  14.8, 12.7, 12.6, 8.0, 7.7, 7.1, 8.4,  
                  7.7,  7.4, 8.1, 4.7, 5.8, 2.8, 3.4,  
                  17.6, 14.5, 13.8, 9.2, 7.8, 8.6, 10.9),
         ucl  = c(12.7, 10.2, 9.7,  7.9, 7.0, 7.0, 6.2,  
                  24.3, 22.7, 22.6, 17.6, 12.1, 11.1, 18.4,  
                  14.8, 15.2, 16.3, 9.0, 13.0, 9.2, 6.6,  
                  31.3, 28.9, 28.4, 23.6, 13.3, 13.9, 25.7))

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.8, reverse = TRUE)

ggplot(dat, aes(x = indicator, y = prev, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl),
                position = dodge, width = 0.25,
                linewidth = 0.4, color = "gray25") +
  coord_flip() +                                              
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(levels(dat$indicator))) +     
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#261100", "#BF5700", "#FDB863", "#E08214")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Prevalence (%)",
                     limits = c(0, 35), breaks = seq(0, 35, 5),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),                 
        legend.position = "top")
```

# Sampling map

```{r}
#install.packages("usmap")
library(usmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

both  <- c("AK","DE","GA","IN","IA","KS","MA","MN","MT","NM","NC","RI","UT","WV","WI")
y2022 <- c("CT","MO","NV","TX","VT","WA")
y2024 <- c("AL","AZ","HI","ID","LA","MD","NJ","ND")

dat <- data.frame(state = c(both, y2022, y2024),
                  status = rep(c("Both 2022 & 2024", "2022 only", "2024 only"),
                               times = c(length(both), length(y2022), length(y2024))))

lab <- c("Both 2022 & 2024" = sprintf("Both 2022 & 2024 (n=%d)", length(both)),
         "2022 only"        = sprintf("2022 only (n=%d)",        length(y2022)),
         "2024 only"        = sprintf("2024 only (n=%d + VI)",     length(y2024)),
         "Not included"     = "Not included")

dat <- dat |>
  mutate(status = factor(status,
                         levels = c("Both 2022 & 2024","2022 only","2024 only")))

plot_usmap(data = dat, values = "status", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Both 2022 & 2024" = "#111111",
                               "2022 only"        = "#4D4D4D",
                               "2024 only"        = "#9E9E9E"),
                    labels = lab[1:3],
                    na.value = "#EEEEEE",
                    na.translate = TRUE,
                    breaks = levels(dat$status)) +
  labs(fill = NULL,
       caption = "VI = U.S. Virgin Islands (not shown on map).") +
  theme_void(base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8))
```
